question: Can you identify the hubs that saw more than a 20% increase in finished orders from February to March?
sql:
SELECT 
    h.hub_id,
    h.hub_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 END) as feb_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 END) as mar_count,
    100.0 * (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 END), 0) as pct_increase
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN hubs h ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
    AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 END) > 0
    AND 100.0 * (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 END)) / COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 END) > 20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
